items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yes. You met Irene, didn't you? Wrote Good Morning, Irene. Yes.

ctx.x: ? : Well, my brother, Donnie, he knew more about it and I know we used to sit down when I was living, well, you were living there, too. I was visiting my brother and their family after I got married. And on my father's side, the people came from Massachusetts because some of them, when they came, I guess they came you know they were slaves ... the grandparents and when they came to Massachusetts, some of them took the name of Higginbotham and the others took the name of Hawkins. Because the Hawkins I remember. I…
